task_title: boardctl init subcommand — bootstrap topology-A board files
task_criteria: The boardctl CLI gains an 'init' subcommand: (1) 'boardctl init [-C dir] [--project P --namespace NS]' on an empty directory writes the three topology-A files (.coding-hermes/board/tasks.jsonl, events.jsonl, board.jsonl header), idempotent re-run exits 0 with no clobber; (2) 'boardctl create' works after init on an empty tasks.jsonl by building rows from a built-in default schema (no mirror-from-last failure); (3) the stale topology-B error no longer references board.db or scripts/update; it states topology B is read-only and to migrate by splitting line 1 of tasks.jsonl into board.jsonl; (4) go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... -count=1 -short all pass; (5) README documents 'Start a board' using init.
